Subject: AcmeFin POC: proposed plan & success criteria (post-call recap)

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the proposed next steps so we have alignment before kicking off the POC: 

Summary of goals
- Validate that Redwood reduces inference latency for your anonymized real-time scoring pipeline to < 100ms p95 for 512-token requests.
- Demonstrate a 2x reduction in per-token cost vs your current hosted setup (after batching & prefix caching).
- Confirm model quality meets business rules (false positive rate < 2% on the flagged transactions test set).

Proposed POC scope (2 weeks)
- Week 0 (this week): Access & infra prep — provide service account + sample data, grant S3 read of 1 month of anonymized events.
- Week 1: Integration & baseline — deploy Redwood demo, run baseline workload.
- Week 2: Optimization & evaluation — apply batching/caching/quant profiles and run final evaluation.

Ownership
- AcmeFin: provide anonymized sample dataset, define evaluation test set and success criteria owner (Sam / Priya).
- Redwood: integration support (Marcus), runtime tuning (Vivek), and project coordination (me).

Attachments: redwood-POC-plan.xlsx (POC timeline + task list).

Next steps / asks (can you confirm by EoD Wed?):
1) Provide S3 read role or sample data bucket URL.
2) Confirm success criteria owner and the evaluation test set file name.
3) Preferred kickoff time on Friday for a 30m technical sync.

I'll schedule the Friday slot tentatively and adjust based on your availability.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligns with our internal priorities. A few clarifications from our side: 

Success criteria (will own: Sam Lee)
- p95 latency < 100ms for 512 tokens on our test harness.
- Overall model recall >= 98% on the curated fraud test set.
- End-to-end throughput of at least 150 TPS on a single inference cluster.

Evaluation plan notes
- We'll provide a curated test set (anonymized) and a separate validation set for regression checks.
- Sam will upload the test set to a temp S3 bucket (link to follow).

Access items: we can provision an IAM role and will share the bucket ARN by tomorrow. Priya prefers kickoff Fri Nov 6 at 10am EST.

Also attaching our internal evaluation checklist (acmefin-eval-metrics.docx) — contains metric definitions and acceptance thresholds.

appreciate it,
Alex

Thanks Alex — looking forward to the data. Quick technical checklist from the Redwood SE side so we can hit the timeline: 

SE pre-kickoff tasks (need from AcmeFin ASAP)
- Temp S3 bucket ARN + IAM principal for read access (or temporary presigned URLs for sample files).
- Sample of production config (payload schema) and an example 512-token request.
- Confirmation on any sensitive fields we should mask before ingest.

Redwood deliverables for Week 1
- Demo deployment with the same model variant we discussed (r-instruct-1.1x).
- Baseline latency/cost report (CSV) and a lightweight dashboard link.

I'll be on the Friday kickoff and plan to bring Naomi for CS onboarding (she'll cover SLAs and support model). If you have any constraints on egress or IP allowlisting let us know so we can provide IP ranges.
